name: dual-agent-workflow
description: Claude + Codex as one team: Claude plans, reviews and polishes the UI; Codex builds the backend and a first working frontend; local scripts gate and verify every phase, with a functional Playwright audit (headless, or headed so you can watch) at close. Installs Claude Code, Codex CLI, Playwright, graphify and the ponytail and taste-skill plugins. Local only: never edits tracked files; plugin updates sync projects automatically.
